owner_authorization.quote: 刚刚的10000张不错 弄成训练数据集 同时弄好负样本
owner_authorization.interpretation: The delivered 10,000-example family may be materialized as clean YOLO images and labels, and an automatically mined negative set may be added. This is a batch-level weak-label authorization, not a claim that every boundary received a separate Gold verdict.

positive_source.positive_contract: Use every accepted source window and exact accepted box unchanged. Re-render a clean chart from the pinned OHLCV, then require that drawing the accepted red box recreates the delivered review PNG byte-for-byte.

renderer.positive_box_source: exact x/y geometry from the accepted review manifest; no global shift, reboxing or resizing

split.method: global chronological cutoff over complete render-plus-label dependency intervals; never random
split.between_rules: materialize under excluded/ for lineage, but data.yaml must not expose it
split.dependency_end: max(render end, core end + 5 completed-history label bars)

negative_sampling.kind_assignment: Odd positive source_order -> easy; even -> hard, yielding exact 5000/5000 without looking at market outcomes.

completed_no_launch_condition.atr_anchor: core_end + 2, matching the accepted retrieval family
completed_no_launch_condition.purpose: Use future only to define a safe negative label. Rendered pixels remain the exact matched window and never touch repository holdout.

hard_definition.meaning: The six MAs are visually dense, but the completed move fails the strict no-launch condition. These are model-relevant hard backgrounds.

easy_definition.meaning: Clearly non-dense background satisfying the same strict no-launch label.

positive_guard.strict_candidate_source: Re-run the hash-pinned accepted-family gate on each used source and guard every hit before negative selection.

negative_sampling.capacity_policy: Fail closed if any same-source/same-quarter/same-split pair cannot be filled; never cross symbols, reuse windows, approach a protected positive, or relax no-launch thresholds.

sources.source_policy: Read only the manifest-pinned source prefixes strictly before holdout. No fallback data source is permitted.

controls.positive_overlay_parity: 10,000/10,000 clean re-renders must recreate the accepted boxed PNG byte-for-byte after the accepted rectangle is drawn.
controls.shifted_box_null: On a deterministic sample, cyclically use the next positive's box. Expected byte match is zero; this proves parity is geometry-specific rather than a renderer-only tautology.
controls.full_file_qa: Decode and hash every actual image; parse every positive label; require every negative label to be byte-empty and every input to contain zero exact overlay-red pixels.
